components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Creates a local sandbox order after the server confirms it.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; margin-top: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #17664f; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font: 700 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgba(23,102,79,.16); transition: transform .16s, background .16s, box-shadow .16s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #124d3d; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(23,102,79,.2); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(23,102,79,.27); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .68; transform: none; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Checkout Panel
components.description: Separates cart and summary information with one quiet border.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid #e4e8e2; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; color: #17221f; font: 690 16px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; }

components.name: Cart Select
components.description: Selects the synthetic cart amount and shows its current coupon threshold.
components.css: .ds-select-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; color: #3c4943; font: 670 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-select-wrap { position: relative; } .ds-select { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 44px 0 14px; border: 1px solid #dce2dc; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #17221f; font: 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; appearance: none; transition: border-color .16s, box-shadow .16s; } .ds-select:focus-visible { border-color: #17664f; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(23,102,79,.12); } .ds-select-arrow { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 16px; width: 12px; height: 8px; color: #7c8781; pointer-events: none; } .ds-select-arrow svg { display: block; width: 12px; height: 8px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Local Sandbox Chip
components.description: Keeps the local-only boundary visible in the page header.
components.css: .ds-local-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid #cde1d4; border-radius: 999px; background: #f3f8f4; color: #124d3d; font: 650 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-local-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #439a70; }

components.name: Checkout Stepper
components.description: Shows the three checkout stages and highlights the current one.
components.html: 1 Cart2 Confirm3 Complete
components.css: .ds-steps { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #66726b; font: 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-step { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-step-current { color: #124d3d; font-weight: 690; } .ds-step-current::before { display: grid; width: 24px; height: 24px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #17664f; color: #fff; content: "2"; }

components.name: Coupon Status
components.description: Keeps the coupon rule, eligibility note, and state together.
components.css: .ds-coupon-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 13px; min-height: 76px; padding: 15px 16px; border: 1px solid #f0d7ca; border-radius: 12px; background: #fffaf7; color: #563a2e; font: 690 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-coupon-state { color: #17664f; font-weight: 720; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-coupon-card[data-state="below-threshold"] .ds-coupon-state { color: #a64624; }

components.name: Payable Total
components.description: Makes the final amount visually distinct and easy to compare.
components.css: .ds-payable { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding-top: 18px; margin-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid #e9ede8; color: #4c5952; font: 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-payable strong { color: #17221f; font: 710 30px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-payable small { margin-right: 3px; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -.02em; }

components.name: Synthetic Scenario Action
components.description: Runs one approved Silver/Gold scenario in an isolated in-memory Run without creating a purchase.
components.css: .ds-scenario-action { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: #17664f; color: #fff; font-weight: 680; }

components.name: Membership Oracle Observation
components.description: Shows effective tier, authorization observation, membership event state, and the claimed coupon ledger from the local server.
components.css: .ds-oracle { border: 1px solid #e4e8e2; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; } .ds-oracle dd { color: #17221f; font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Expected Check Row
components.description: Keeps each approved rule label visible while showing pending or locally observed state separately.
components.css: .ds-expected-check { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ec; color: #303b35; }

narrative.overview: The interface keeps synthetic business outcomes easy to inspect across the E1 checkout and M1 membership state overview. Warm neutral grounds, white bordered surfaces, concise labels, and a clear type scale help operators compare state without turning demos into production storefronts. Deep green carries primary actions and positive observations; terracotta marks lifecycle actions and unresolved states. M1 separates contract expectations from local observations and keeps coupon expiry unknown when no exact expiry is defined.
keyCharacteristics: Green for primary actions and positive observations; terracotta for lifecycle actions and unresolved states.
Clear separation between synthetic sandbox actions and real commerce.
Contract expectations stay separate from observations in an isolated local Run.

rules.name: The Outcome-First Color Rule
rules.body: Use green only when the synthetic business state is positive or the action is primary. Use terracotta for a clearly unmet condition; never let accent color imply a real payment or entitlement.

rules.name: The Amount Legibility Rule
rules.body: Keep payable values prominent and aligned with tabular numerals. Heading and amount tracking must remain no tighter than -0.04em.

rules.name: The One-Elevation Rule
rules.body: A panel uses its border for separation; a raised shadow belongs to an actionable control.

dos: Do use the established green and terracotta colors to distinguish outcomes.
Do format money with tabular numerals and keep the payable amount prominent.
Do keep the local-only, no-payment notice near the main action.
Distinguish a seed-time coupon observation from a later expiry result.
Label local observations separately from contract expectations.
donts: Don't combine a broad panel shadow with its border.
Don't draw interface icons with text glyphs; use CSS shapes for simple dots and SVG for the select chevron.
Don't tighten heading or amount tracking past -0.04em.
Don't make synthetic checkout copy imply a real charge or fulfillment.
Do not claim coupon expiry or propagation timing that the demo did not observe.
Do not imply that a local authorization probe creates a Gold-only purchase.
